## Summary

A **power of two** is a number of the form $2^{n}$ where $n$ is an [[integer|0C4JS9RF5M]], that is, the result of exponentiation with the number two as the base and integer $n$ as the exponent. In the fast-growing hierarchy, $2^{n}$ is exactly equal to $f_1^n(1)$. In the Hardy hierarchy, $2^{n}$ is exactly equal to $H_{\omega{n}}(1)$.
